implementation_summary: One runner test (24 cases) that starts a RunnerServer on port 3761 over a temp data folder, seeds a finished English and Tamil audit through the store, then drives edits, settings, Shortlist data, a runner restart, every export format, the bundle, the Pitch Glimpse (html and pdf) and the Owner Audit over HTTP with the real Chromium PDF printer. It proves REQ-018..022, 025..027, the ADR 0018 word list and no release verdict across all outputs, Pitch Glimpse PDF page count of 1 on A4, and no outbound network activity (fetch, http(s).request and Chromium requests spied).

tests_executed.name: Audit Documents end-to-end flow (runner + Chromium)
tests_executed.output_excerpt: Test Files 1 passed (1); Tests 24 passed (24); Duration ~21s (run twice, both green)

tests_proposed: Add a case asserting a third concurrent PDF through the running runner returns 503 with Retry-After (covered only at route level in BE-510).
risks: G7 must add 'audit-documents-flow' to BROWSER_TESTS.runner in vitest.workspace.ts; the test launches Chromium and a runner.
Tamil glyph rendering and fonts in the PDF are not asserted (page count and A4 size only); the visual part of REQ-022 AC-3 stays under the BE-507 waiver.

The Chromium request spy may record zero requests (data: URLs may not emit events); the test accepts an empty list and separately asserts the printer was called with HTML identical to the HTML export.
playwright is loaded via createRequire from packages/core (the runner does not depend on it), to spy on the same chromium object the printer uses.
REQ-026 phase is checked by label count, not per item; priority and effort are checked per item.
Fixed port 3761 because RunnerServer treats port 0 as 3001 (F-021); no other test file uses it.
